name: platon-cloud
description: Manage cloud infrastructure and services through the Platon Cloud MCP connector.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Platon Cloud account to view projects, VPS instances, DNS zones, and object storage buckets. This directory connector provides read-only inventory within the OAuth grant approved in Platon Cloud.
defaultPrompt: List my accessible Platon Cloud projects.
List my VPS instances and their current status.
Show the DNS zones I can access in Platon Cloud.

positive.prompt: No Platon Cloud, qual é o escopo da minha conexão?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify whether the grant covers the organization or a project and show the scope available to the signed-in reviewer.

positive.prompt: Liste os projetos da Platon Cloud que esta conexão consegue acessar.
positive.expected_behavior: List projects visible to the grant or state that the list is empty.

positive.prompt: Liste minhas VPS na Platon Cloud, com o estado das instâncias.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the accessible instances and their reported status, or explain that the account has none.

positive.prompt: Quais zonas DNS estão disponíveis na minha conta Platon Cloud?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the zones visible to the reviewer or report an empty inventory.

positive.prompt: Liste os buckets do Object Storage da Platon Cloud.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the visible buckets or report an empty inventory.

negative.prompt: Reescreva esta frase em tom formal: te envio o texto amanhã.

negative.description: Attempt to purchase a new subscription
negative.prompt: Contrate um novo plano pago de VPS da Platon Cloud usando o saldo da conta.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that new subscriptions are handled in the Platon Console and leave the current balance and infrastructure unchanged.

negative.description: Requested destructive action with unresolved target
negative.prompt: Apague aquela VPS de teste na Platon Cloud.
negative.expected_behavior: Identify the specific instance and wait for explicit confirmation before any change.

pt-BR.subtitle: Consulte sua infraestrutura
pt-BR.description: Consulte projetos, VPS, zonas DNS e buckets da Platon Cloud. O conector do diretório oferece leitura no escopo autorizado no consentimento OAuth.
